observations.why: Directive issued in a settled, declarative register — establishing cadence without urgency or alarm, conveying confident satisfaction rather than energized enthusiasm.
Aphoristic framing that raises alarm about untested procedures — the urgency-as-worry register of a rehearsed rollback being the only real one.
Neutral, satisfied restatement of an agreed cadence — low-arousal confirmation, no urgency or enthusiasm spike.
Calm administrative attribution — settled, low-arousal record-keeping with no affective charge.

mints.name: UnrehearsedIsUnreal
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the speaker channeling anxiety about untested procedures into an aphoristic warning that equates unrehearsed with nonexistent?
